decisions.reason: As a template close to the core hosting and shop business, it is likely retained for now, but the limited public commitment on the website makes it easier to withdraw than more heavily backed launches if uptake disappoints.

This responsive website template fits the firm's established customer base and broad web-project offer, so management is inclined to continue it, although its relatively light website presentation means sunk-cost pressure is only moderate.
Premium customer support sits directly in the firm's core promise of expert service and 24/7 help, so both strategic fit and commitment make management very likely to persist with it.
The software version management tool builds on the firm's platform capabilities, reflects in-house development, and was given its own page, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.

Although this data-processing-contract tool is more distant from the core offer, the dedicated page and multiple-model product line suggest visible commitment and investment that make management likely to continue it at least another year.
